keywords.def: The use of physics to diagnose and treat disease.

en.text: Physics supports every other science: chemistry (atoms, heat, spectra), biology (balance, fluids, sound, nerves, light), astronomy (gravity, light, spectra), geology (waves, magnetism), engineering and technology, medicine (X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, radiotherapy), defence (radar R = ct/2, infrared) and communication (electromagnetic waves).

screens.title: Warm up: where is this physics used?
Unit summary
paras: Sciences depend on and reinforce each other.
Chemistry is rooted in atomic and molecular physics.
Biology uses mechanics, fluids, sound, electricity and light.
Astronomers use light, atomic physics and Newton's laws.
Medical devices like X-ray, MRI, CT and ultrasound come from physics.
Radar and infrared night vision use electromagnetic waves.

items.text: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about reflection and refraction of sound waves and their applications?
opts: A. Reflection and refraction of sound are used to detect flaws in metals and to help people park their cars.
B. Refraction of sound is the change in its direction as it travels through a medium having different densities.
C. In pre-natal scanning, reflection and refraction of sound allows doctors to monitor the progress of a developing body.
D. Reflection of sound (echo) is formed when sound enters a medium of varying densities.
items.ans: D. Reflection of sound (echo) is formed when sound enters a medium of varying densities.
items.why: Reflection (echo) is sound bouncing back from a boundary/surface. A change of direction as sound passes into regions of different density is refraction, not reflection — so D is the incorrect statement. A is true (ultrasonic flaw detection, parking sensors); B is the definition of refraction; C is true (ultrasound pre-natal scanning uses echoes from tissue boundaries).

items.text: An FM radio signal is transmitted from a radio station at a frequency of 1.5×10⁸ Hz. If the wavelength of the radio wave is 2.00 m, the speed of the FM signal is
items.why: Wave speed v = fλ. v = (1.5×10⁸ Hz)(2.00 m) = 3.0×10⁸ m/s — the speed of light, as expected for an electromagnetic (radio) wave. B divides f by λ; C doubles the answer; D is λ/f.
